# Phase 17 – Internal Ops, Hiring & Delegation Blueprint

Brand: **Digital Transition Marketing (DTM)**
AI System / Bot: **Neon Vision**
Objective: Build a **lean, AI-first operating system** that scales revenue without scaling chaos, headcount, or founder burnout.

---

## 17.1 Core Operating Philosophy (DTM Rulebook)

DTM does **not** scale like a traditional agency.

**Rules:**
• Automate before hiring
• Delegate only after automation plateaus
• Humans handle judgment, relationships, and taste
• AI handles volume, repetition, monitoring, and optimization
• Founder time is the most protected asset

This phase ensures **Neon Vision absorbs operational load**, not people.

---

## 17.2 Automation vs Delegation Decision Tree

Use this logic for every task:

**AUTOMATE if:**
• Task is repetitive
• Rules-based or pattern-driven
• Requires speed or 24/7 monitoring
• Failure cost is low to medium

**DELEGATE if:**
• Task requires creative judgment
• Client trust or persuasion is involved
